data.name: Hotel Tropicana
data.address: Amapas 214, Zona Romántica, PlayaLos Muertos, 48380 Puerto Vallarta, Jal., Mexico
data.description:
Set on a private beach, this relaxed hotel in a balcony-lined building is 2 km from Puerto Vallarta's lively Malecón and 13 km from Vallarta Under Sea diving school.
Simple rooms have TVs, safes and ceiling fans. Upgraded rooms add air-conditioning and balconies with sea and garden views, while suites offer living/dining areas. Upgraded suites feature kitchenettes. Room service is available.
There's a relaxed bar/restaurant serving seafood, as well as an outdoor pool and a garden.
